info.name: Unified money-movement feed for the broker's Transactions tab.

items.docs:
GET /apis/v2/treasury/activity?type=&limit=&offset=

Merges three sources into one date-ordered list:

* Treasury FA transactions (except payout rows — see below), which carry
  regulatory receipts (``has_receipt``, fetched via
  ``/treasury/transactions/{id}/receipt``);
* payouts of the payments balance (from StripePayout, so payouts to the
  broker's own external bank are included; the payout rows mirrored in
  the FA ledger are excluded to avoid listing the same payout twice);

info.name: Balances of the broker's Treasury financial accounts.

items.docs:
GET /apis/v2/treasury/balances

Served from the local FA snapshots, which every money-movement webhook
refreshes — no Stripe round trip per request. ``updated_at`` tells the
client how fresh each snapshot is.

info.name: Money movements of the broker's Treasury financial accounts.

params.name: ordering
params.description: Which field to use when ordering the results.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

items.docs:
Connected accounts have no Stripe dashboard, so brokers retrieve the
hosted regulatory receipt of regulated transactions here (Stripe money
transmission license requirement). Receipt URLs are fetched from Stripe
per request — never stored — since they rotate and expire after 60 days.
